title: David
summary: Son of Jesse of Bethlehem; king over Judah 7½ years at Hebron and over all Israel 33 years at Jerusalem, 40 years in all (2 Sam 5:4–5).
description: Added with the judges-period records from James B. Jordan's chronology (secondary display).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (F. N. Jones): 1085 BC (no higher-tier year available). Jordan (secondary display) never sets the sort.

birth.citation: Jones, Chart No. 4 "Judges to the First 3 Kings" (© 1993 Floyd Jones; chart text revised "As of 2007"), timeline band
Ussher, Annals of the World, Fourth Age §394 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)
Jordan, From Creation to Solomon (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2, Biblical Horizons, Oct. 2001), ch. 11 "The Era of the Judges and the Reign of Saul", p. 52
birth.note: 2001 revision. Jordan's 1991 list (BC 3:8) has an earlier year; see the second Jordan entry. p. 49: "David would not be born for eight more years" after Saul's rejection; p. 51: "David was born in the tenth year of Saul's reign (2 Samuel 5:4)". Through New Eyes (1988), ch. 15 n. 1: "David was born 406 years after the entrance into Canaan (1 Kings 6:1; 2 Samuel 5:4)" (interval as printed; on Jordan's 2001 years 2919 is 406 years after the Exodus, 2513, not after the entry). Judges (1985), p. 239: "David was born in the tenth year of Saul's reign" (2 Sam. 5:4; Acts 13:21).

birth.citation: Jordan, "Chronology and Kings (II)," Biblical Chronology 3:8 (August 1991), section "The Judges", summary list
birth.note: 1991 scheme, superseded by Jordan himself in 2001 (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2 dates the whole judges sequence 26 years later because he there ends the 300 years of Judg 11:26 when Ammon took the villages, AM 2860, not at Jephthah's victory).

death.note: Jordan gives no year for David's death; he dates "2949 - Accession of David", "2950 - David year 1" and "2989 - Accession of Solomon" (From Creation to Solomon, 2001, pp. 52–53; BC 3:8, 1991, has 2949 and 2989). Not inferred.

death.date: 2990a AM, 1015 BC ("After David gave instructions to his son Solomon, he died")
death.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Fourth Age §459 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)

death.note: Jones's Chart No. 4 shows David's 40-year reign 1055–1015 BC and "SOLOMON KING MADE PRO-REX DURING LAST YEAR OF DAVID'S LIFE" but prints no death year. Not inferred.
